Research the effectiveness of markup/tag syntax in LLM prompts. Search for empirical data on how well models follow markers like [IMPORTANT], [OPTIONAL], <strict>, <relaxed>, XML tags, markdown headers, etc. Specific questions: 1) Do models actually respect inline markers in prompts? 2) What's the failure rate? 3) Do different models (GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Llama) respond differently to markers? 4) What about small/local models (3B-8B params)? 5) What about instruction hierarchy — does it work better? 6) What about Anthropic's <> XML tag format vs markdown vs custom syntax? 7) How does marker placement affect compliance (beginning vs middle of prompt)? Search for papers, blog posts, and empirical comparisons. Report with concrete numbers.
